items.title: Jerry Jerome interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: Herschel was a very good friend of mine, Herschel Evans, the tenor saxophone player with Basie.

ctx.x: Did Lester Young have any peculiarities that you noticed at the time?

Well it was a cute thing. When the Basie band came up to New York, this was the finished band, this was not like the band that was in Kansas City, this was a full band, they had full brass, full saxes. And Lester and Herschel Evans were playing in this band. And Lester had a cute thing. He had a string tied between his stand and the next, the third alto stand, and in the middle of it was a little bell, like a tinkerbell. If anybody in the band goofed, he’d ring it. And it was the funniest thing. Somebody’d be…
That’s great. And he would be holding his horn at that strange—
